blind.B1: Yes. Synergist-ablation mechanical overload (MOV) of the plantaris is the paper's in-vivo resistance-exercise model (ABS.p1, S2.3.p1). GEO has 20 old male mice, 2x2 treatment (vehicle/D+Q) x surgery (sham/MOV), n=5 per cell. Exercise factor = MOV samples (10); the paper's RNA-seq uses only the 10 MOV samples (S2.8.p1).
blind.B2: Main comparison: D+Q vs vehicle in old mice after 14 d MOV, n=5 vs 5 (S2.8.p1, S3.5.p1, Fig. 6 legend N=5/group). Sham samples are not described as sequenced in the paper.
blind.B3: No repeated measures: one plantaris per mouse, each mouse is in one treatment arm (S2.8.p1; gavage arms are different animals). The packet's pairing key (surgery + index suffix across treatment) joins different animals by numbering; the residual-correlation 'support' most likely reflects the shared surgery effect, not a shared animal. No animal ID in GEO.
blind.B4: The paper does not say; S2.8.p1 only states DESeq2 on vehicle vs D+Q (n=5/group), i.e. a two-group comparison.
blind.B5: S2.8.p1: 'Differential gene expression was analyzed using DESeq2 (FDR<0.05)'; no fold-change cutoff. Count: 'approximately 2,000 differentially expressed genes' D+Q vs vehicle (S3.5.p1, Fig. 6a); Fig. 6 legend marks '*p < 0.05' for violin plots.

checks.evidence: Run decision matches B1: MOV arm present, analyzable; MOV described as resistance-exercise model (S2.3.p1, study caveats).
trt DQ/Veh 10/10, surg MOV/Sham 10/10, cells 5 each; primary subset MOV only, Veh control, n=5 v 5 as S2.8.p1. Exclusions: none. Sham samples declared as a paper/data discrepancy.
Primary DQ vs Veh (treatment vs its control); exploratory MOV vs Sham with Sham as control; Ddit4/Cryab down and Igf1 etc. up agree with S3.5.p1.

No repeated animals (B3); covariance record says one plantaris per independent mouse. The mechanical pairing_key_candidate is a numbering artefact across different animals (key pools surgery-matched samples, so the correlation 0.84 is the surgery effect); not blocking.
Paper silent; two-group fit on MOV subset as primary, joint 2x2 fit as exploratory, counts 13 vs 14 close, both reported.
No batch/lane/housing/sex variable in GEO or paper; one sex only; treatment and surgery fully crossed.
Non-integer Partek E/M estimated counts (integer_fraction 0.71) rounded and DESeq2 used as in S2.8.p1; frac_p_gt_0.9 0.082, frac_p_lt_0.05 0.099, no pile-up.
padj<0.05, no fold-change cutoff, matches S2.8.p1 (B5); the raw p<0.05 audit rule is labelled, not applied. Raw p gives 1,499, not ~2,000, so no rule in the table reproduces the paper's count.

Same contrast (DQ vs Veh, 14 d MOV) and same rule, but 13 vs ~2,000 DEGs; method record sets paper_route status 'reproduced' and the study caveat says the paper's figure 'most likely reflects an unadjusted p cutoff', whereas raw p<0.05 gives 1,499-1,631, still well short of ~2,000.
checks.fix: Reword paper_route status to 'method reproduced, DEG count not reproduced' and soften the unadjusted-p explanation to a possibility.

human_items: Which threshold to report when the paper's ~2,000 DEGs fit no stated rule (FDR<0.05 gives 13; raw p<0.05 gives 1,499): open policy question.
Whether synergist-ablation MOV counts as an exercise model (resistance-exercise model per the paper): open policy question.
summary: 分析正确识别了论文的主比较(老年小鼠14天机械过载下D+Q对比vehicle,各n=5),分组、方向、模型、矩阵处理和FDR<0.05阈值均与论文一致。系统标记的配对键只是跨不同动物的编号巧合,实际无重复测量。唯一小问题:论文约2000个DEG与本分析的13个差距很大,记录中'reproduced'和'未校正p值最可能'的说法略强。
